paragraphs: Rabbi Pinchas ben Aruba, a Tanna of a baraita.
Mentioned in Gittin 56b, saying, “I was among Rome's leading men; when Titus died, they opened his brain,” etc.
In Bekhorot 38b, Rabbi Yochanan reports him on a medical matter.

notes.text: The brain-opening narrative is quoted as Hyman reports it; the medical teaching is a separate attestation.
